Keu escape karakter kontrol tunggai (' \/) nyan, droeneueh jeuet ngui \. Contoh: Field1 == I\'m. Droeneueh jeuet gabong le kondisi. Contoh: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ngon setelan awai, mandum operator geupeubuet nibak wie u uneuen. Droeneueh jeuet ubah urutan ngon boh tanda kurong. Contoh: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Droeneueh jeuet mita ruang teks ngon regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

globalSearch-instructions-description: Mita jeuet na operator keu peucok hasé mita. Operator geutuléh ngön nan operator ngön nilè nyang geupeuceurai lé titek dua. Umpama, operator `list:Blocked` bataih mita bak kad nyang na lam dapeuta nan *Blocked*. Meunyoe nilè na spasi atawa karakter khusus, beu geupeuduek lam tanda petik (umpama `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).

globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - kad milik papan nyang geutetapkan bak tim *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - kad nyang tempo hingga *<n>* uroe nibak jinoe. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ peudeuih mandum kad nyang ka leupah tanggal tempo.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - kad nyang geupeugot *<n>* uroe ka leupah atawa kureueng
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - kad nyang geuubah *<n>* uroe ka leupah atawa kureueng
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - mandum kad nyang geuarsip ngön nyang hana geuarsip
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - nyang *<field>* saboh nibak `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` atawa `__predicate_member__`. Peuduek `-` di keue *<field>* keu cari nyang hana na nila bak ruang nyan (umpama `has:-due` cari kad nyang hana tanggal tempo).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - nyang *<sort-name>* saboh nibak `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` atawa `__predicate_modified__`. Keu susun meunuron, peuduek `-` di keue nama susun.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - nyang *<n>* angka bulat positif nyang peunyata jumlah kad nyang geupeudeuh tiep halaman.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Operator nyang saban geupeu-*OR*. Kad nyang cocok ngon barang saboh syarat geupeuwoe.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` peuwoe kad nyang na lam dapeuta nan *Blocked* atawa *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Operator nyang beda geupeu-*AND*. Mantong kad nyang cocok ngön mandum operator nyang beda nyang geupeuwoe. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` peuwoe mantong kad lam dapeuta *Available* ngön label *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Uroe jeuet geutuléh lagèe angka bulat positif atawa negatif, atawa ngui `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` atawa `__predicate_year__` keu masa jinoe.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Pencarian teks hana beda huruf rayek ngon huruf ubit.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Ngon setelan awai, kad lam Arsip hana geumita.

feature-views-overview-desc: Angka, peusapat meunurot ureuëng nyang geubri buet, rencana buet, papan kontrol ngon papan raya.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Daftar buet produk nyang mantöng na, masa buet paneuk, laporan masa nyan ngon bagah buet.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Buet nyang mantöng na, buet nyang ka lheuh, aliran nyang teukumpôi, watèe peubuet ngon watèe nibak peumintaan sampoe lheuh, jeumeulah buet nyang ka lheuh, trep buet preh, halangan, Monte Carlo ngon ukuran aliran laén.
feature-views-map-desc: Kad lagee tanda bak gamba nyang ka geupeuek.
feature-approval-required: Peubiyeu fitur nyang geutamah lé peubarô WeKan hana aktip sampoe admin geupeuaktip
feature-preview-admins: Admin geukalon fitur nyang hana aktip keu geucuba dilèe
feature-pilot-users: Ureuëng cuba nyang jeuet cit kalon fitur nyang hana aktip
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Nan ureuëng ngui, peupisah ngon koma
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Ka teukeubah. Nan ureuëng ngui nyoe hana meurumpok:
card-field-visibility-desc: Ruang Peuatôran Papan / Kad nyang jeuet geupeuleumah le papan. Ruang nyang h'an geucentang geusuweue nibak bandum kad, minikad ngon Peuatôran Papan / Kad bak bandum papan. Hana data kad atawa peuatôran papan nyang meuubah, ngon meunyoe geucentang lom tiep papan geupeuleumah lagee geuatô dilee. Urotan ruang nakeuh milék tiep papan.
cards-loading-auto: Otomatis (peumuat lambat keu papan rayeuk mantong)
cards-loading-description: WeKan muat kad papan keudroe: papan rayeuk (leubèh nibak bataih ukoran) muat kad nyang deuh jinoe mantong (scroll hana putôh) ngön jumeulah langsông, mangat tetap bagaih ngön ngui leubèh bacut memori ngön bandwidth, teuma papan ubit muat mandum kad keu rupa nyang paleng mudah ngön fitur leungkap. Hana peue nyang peureulee geuatô. Operator mantong jeuet paksa mode ngön variabel lingkungan CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) ngön CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Muat kad lazy mantong percubaan: jumeulah kad ngön bataih WIP beutôi, teuma rupa Kalèndè/Tabel/Gantt ngön pileh le mantong peuleumah kad nyang ka geumuat. Muat lom papan nyang teungoh meuhah lheueh droeneueh ubah nyoe.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Watèe geuhudep, mandum taut (bandua taut markdown lagèe [label](url) ngön tag HTML meuntah <a href>) sabe geupeuleumah lagèe teks biasa nyang hana jeuet geuklik bak tiep ruang teks kaya (judôi papan ngön kad, deskripsi, komen, checklist, ngön laén-laén). Nyoe mangat bek na taut nyang jeuet geuklik nyang peusesat. Default maté, nyan sebab taut mantong jeuet geuklik.
always-show-code-as-text: Sabe peudeuh mandum kode lagee teks biasa
always-show-code-as-text-description: Watèe geuhudep, teks kaya hana tom geupeuleumah lagèe markdown atawa HTML: mandum sumber sabe geupeuleumah lagèe teks biasa bak tiep ruang teks kaya (judôi papan ngön kad, deskripsi, komen, checklist, ngön laén-laén). Nyoe peuleumah isi nyang teusöm — komen HTML (<!-- -->), tujuan taut markdown, JavaScript ngön kode laén — mangat mandum kode sabe deuh, hana jeuet geuklik, ngön hana jalan. Default maté, nyan sebab markdown geupeuleumah lagèe biasa.
disable-all-import-description: Watèe geuhudep, mandum fitur impor geupeumaté: impor papan nibak WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea ngön Forgejo, meunan cit clone papan. Pileh menu impor geupeusöm ngön server tulak tiep lakèe impor. Default maté.
disable-all-export-description: Watèe geuhudep, mandum fitur ekspor geupeumaté: ekspor papan lagèe WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, atawa u NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, ngön ekspor saboh lampiran. Pileh menu ekspor geupeusöm ngön server tulak tiep lakèe ekspor. Default maté.
disable-import-avatars-description: Watèe geuhudep, avatar (gamba profil ureueng ngui) hana tom geuimpor. Nyoe meuliput impor WeKan JSON, impor Trello, ngön sinkron avatar nibak provider identitas luwa watèe tamong (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Nan ngön data laén mantong geuimpor; avatar mantong nyang geulangkah. Default maté.
disable-export-avatars-description: Watèe geuhudep, avatar (gamba profil ureueng ngui) hana tom geupeutamong watèe ekspor papan (ekspor WeKan JSON ngön CSV). Nan ureueng ngui ngön data laén mantong geuekspor; avatar mantong nyang hana geupeutamong. Default maté.
anonymize-import-users: Peusöm identitas ureueng ngui lam impor
anonymize-import-users-description: Watèe geuhudep, impor papan WeKan JSON geugantoe nan ureueng ngui, nan leungkap ngön inisial tiep ureueng ngui nyang geuimpor ngön placeholder meunurot numbô (user1, user2, ...), geuboh avatar jih, laju geutuléh lom sebutan @username (ngön ruang requested-by / assigned-by) lam isi kad ngön komen nyang geuimpor. Hana identitas ureueng ngui nyang beutôi nibak papan asai nyang geukeubah. Kata "user" tu'ôt bahsa ureueng nyang impor. Default maté.
anonymize-export-users: Peusom identitas ureueng ngui lam ekspor
anonymize-export-users-description: Watèe geuhudep, ekspor papan geugantoe nan ureueng ngui, nan leungkap ngön inisial tiep ureueng ngui nyang geuekspor ngön placeholder meunurot numbô (user1, user2, ...), geuboh avatar jih, laju geutuléh lom sebutan @username (ngön ruang requested-by / assigned-by) lam isi kad ngön komen. File nyang geuekspor hana geuba identitas ureueng ngui nyang beutôi. Kata "user" tu'ôt bahsa ureueng nyang ekspor. Default maté.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Beutôi droeneueh keuneuk peusöm identitas akun nyoe? Nyoe geugantoe keu sabe nan ureueng ngui, nan leungkap ngön alamat email ngön placeholder nyang hana identitas, geuhapus avatar, ngön geupeumaté tamong. Hana lagèe hapus, papan, kad ngön komen mantong geukeubah riwayat jih ngön mantong peuleumah akun nyoe, mantong identitas jih nyang geupeusöm. Buet nyoe hana jeuet geupeuwoe.
disable-activities-description: Watèe geuhudep, entri feed aktivitas hana tom geurekam ngön hana tom geupeuleumah pat pih (sidebar papan ngön tab aktivitas kad). Hana riwayat soe nyang peubuet peue nyang geukeubah. Default maté.
disable-notifications-description: Watèe geuhudep, WeKan hana tom kirém haba peuingat pantau (lam-app, email atawa layanan laén) keu peue mantong aktivitas. Aktivitas mantong jeuet geurekam (keucuali geupeumaté cit di ateuh); haba peuingat mantong nyang geutham. Default maté.
disable-watch-description: Watèe geuhudep, fitur pantau geupeumaté — ureueng ngui hana jeuet langganan papan, dapeuta atawa kad keu teurimong haba peuingat, ngön tiep usaha keu ubah tingkat pantau geutulak. Default maté.
backup-description: Backup Lampiran, Avatar ngön/atawa Data (mandum koleksi teks nyang kon lampiran atawa avatar). File .zip geukirém langsông u storan nyang geupileh — hana file sementara — lagèe backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, nyang na YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars ngön /data. Storan cloud (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) ngui kredensial nyang geuatô bak tab storan jih.
backup-scope-description: Bandum instans, atawa saboh organisasi. Saleunan organisasi na papeuen jih ngön bandum nyang na bak papeuen nyan, meunan cit lampiran papeuen nyan — teuma hana akun ureueng ngui ngön hana peungatoran instans, sabab nyan geupeugot meusapat lé bandum organisasi. Peuriwang saleunan organisasi geutuléh bak papeuen milek organisasi nyan mantong.
theme-override-all-tenants: Peungatoran nyang meuguna keu mandum ureueng sewa
continuous-backup-description: Jikirém tieb-tieb peugantoe bak database, lampiran, avatar ngon catatan u saboh folder lam padum detik, mangat jeuet geupeuwoe u keadaan bak waktu toh mantong. Jimeukeureuja meusajan ngon saleunan nyang ka geuatoe jadwal, nyang jipeugot arsip peunoh.
continuous-backup-enabled: Peujak saleunan nyang hana putoh bak server nyoe
continuous-backup-target: Folder teumpat keubah (jalur peunoh, bak disk laén, teumpat keubah nyang geubagi bak jaringan atawa mount rclone)
continuous-backup-engine-oplog: Oplog (bak waktu nyan cit, tieb-tieb peugantoe)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: On SQLite (on nyang ka geugantoe bak tieb-tieb sela waktu)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Hana mèsén pangkai data nyang jeuet meukeureuja bak server nyoe
continuous-backup-key-file: File gunci kode rahasia (jalur peunoh di luwa folder teumpat keubah; 64 karakter heksadesimal atawa haba rahasia nyang na paléng kureueng 16 karakter). Keubah saboh saleunan: meunyo hana file nyoe, saleunan hana jeuet geupeubalék.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Hana u teumpat toh pih (folder teumpat keubah mantong)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: File pangkai data SQLite (geupeugot bak bineh saleunan, hana geutuleh ateueh file nyang teungoh geungui meusigoe pih)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Ngui pangkai data SQLite nyang ka geupeugot lom bak watee sistem geupeuphon lom teuma (pangkai data phon nyang geuganto teutab geukeubah)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Peuwoe generasi nyang geupileh u waktu nyang geupileh? Saleunan nyang hana putoh jipiyôh siat watee peumulihan teungoh jijak.
continuous-backup-saved: Peungatoeran saleunan nyang hana putoh ka teukeubah
backup-restore-select-first: Pileh saboh backup nibak daptar leubeh awai.
backup-restore-confirm: Peuwoe backup nyang geupileh? Lampiran/avatar geutuléh u filesystem ngön data u database meunurot mode nyang geupileh.
gcs-key-filename-description: Hawa: jalur u file kunci JSON akun layanan bak server.
gcs-credentials-description: Hawa: tempel kunci JSON akun peulayanan. Peukoseng keu guna file kunci atawa kredensial default.
gcs-permissions-note: Bri akun peulayanan WeKan akses beuet/tuléh u bucket: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → bucket droeneueh → Permissions → Grant access. Bak "New principals", tempel emel akun peulayanan — nilai "client_email" nibak gunci JSON droeneueh — laju pileh peran "Storage Object Admin" ngön Save.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Peukoseng keu keubah nila nyang na jinoe.
gcs-bucket-description: Nan bucket Cloud Storage keu keubah file.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: peusoh (ngui endpoint region). Nyang kompatibel ngön S3: URL Endpoint nibak konsol MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces droeneueh.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → bucket droeneueh → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → nan bucket droeneueh (atawa Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → ureueng ngui droeneueh → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → pileh use case 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Geupeuleumah sabé 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Layar saban ngön Access key ID; 'Secret access key' geupeuleumah sigoe mantong watèe gunci geupeugöt — salén watèe nyan (atawa Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akun droeneueh → nan geupeudeuh di ateuh (cit di yup Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akun droeneueh → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akun droeneueh → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akun droeneueh → Data storage → Containers → container droeneueh (atawa + Container keu peugot saboh).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → peumileh proyek di ateuh → ID proyek droeneueh (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → nan bucket droeneueh (atawa Create keu peugot saboh).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Jalur bak server WeKan u file gunci JSON akun peulayanan nyang ka geucok (geupeugöt di yup). Ngui nyoe ATAWA tempel JSON u ruang di yup.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → akun peulayanan droeneueh → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (geuunggah file). Tempel isi jih keunoe, atawa simpan file dan atur jalur jih di ateuh.
attachment-move-storage-azure: Pindah lampiran u Azure Blob Storage
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Pindah lampiran u Google Cloud Storage
gridfs-enabled-description: Ngui MongoDB GridFS keu storan file
migration-stop-confirm: Peu droeneueh yakin keuneuk peupiyôh mandum migrasi?
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Mangat lampiran ngön avatar jeuet geukalön, pinah awaknyan nibak CollectionFS u Storan laén.
s3-access-key-description: Access key AWS S3 keu autentikasi
s3-bucket-description: Nan S3 bucket keu keubah file
s3-enabled-description: Ngui AWS S3 atawa MinIO keu storan file
s3-endpoint-description: URL endpoint S3 (umpama, s3.amazonaws.com atawa minio.example.com)
s3-secret-key-description: Secret key AWS S3 keu autentikasi
s3-settings-saved: Peuatôran S3 ka geukeubah ngön meuhasé
writable-path-description: Jalur direktori dasar keu storan file
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Geupeubuet paréksa ngön peugöt nyang leungkap keu integritas data papan, lagèe urutan dapeuta, posisi kad, ngön struktur swimlane.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Hapus ngön aman dapeuta soh nyang ganda. Mantong geuhapus dapeuta nyang hana kad NGÖN na dapeuta laén ngön judul saban nyang na kad.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Mita ngön peuwoe kad ngön dapeuta nyang gadoh swimlaneId atawa listId. Peugöt swimlane 'Kad Gadoh' mangat mandum item nyang gadoh jeuet geukalön lom.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Peuwoe mandum swimlane, dapeuta, ngön kad nyang ka geuarsip. SwimlaneId atawa listId nyang gadoh geupeugöt keudroe mangat item jeuet geukalön.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Mita ngön peugöt dapeuta nyang gadoh atawa reuloh lam struktur papan.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Ubah URL avatar keu anggota papan mangat jingui backend storan nyang beutôi, ngön peugöt referensi avatar nyang reuloh.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Ubah mandum URL lampiran file bak papan nyoe mangat jingui backend storan nyang beutôi, ngön peugöt referensi file nyang reuloh.
migrations-admin-only: Mantong peungatô papan nyang jeuet peujak migrasi
migrations-description: Peujak paréksa integritas data ngön peugöt keu papan nyoe. Tiep migrasi jeuet geupeujak sidroe-droe.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Nyoe teuma peubuet migrasi nyang leungkap keu paréksa ngön peugöt integritas data papan. Nyoe jeuet meuhabéh watèe bacut. Neusambong?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Nyoe phôn teuma ubah dapeuta nyang geubagi jeuet dapeuta per-swimlane, laju hapus dapeuta soh nyang na dapeuta ganda ngön judul saban nyang na kad. Mantong dapeuta soh nyang beutôi-beutôi leubèh nyang geuhapus. Neusambong?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Nyoe teuma peugöt swimlane 'Kad Gadoh' ngön peuwoe mandum kad ngön dapeuta nyang gadoh swimlaneId atawa listId. Nyoe mantong keu item nyang hana geuarsip. Neusambong?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Nyoe teuma peuwoe MANDUM swimlane, dapeuta, ngön kad nyang ka geuarsip, mangat jeuet geukalön lom. Item nyang gadoh ID geupeugöt keudroe. Nyoe hana gampông geupeuwoe lom. Neusambong?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Nyoe teuma mita ngön peugöt dapeuta nyang gadoh atawa reuloh lam struktur papan. Neusambong?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Nyoe teuma ubah URL avatar keu anggota papan mangat jingui backend storan nyang beutôi. Neusambong?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Nyoe teuma ubah mandum URL lampiran file bak papan nyoe mangat jingui backend storan nyang beutôi. Neusambong?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: Hana swimlane, dapeuta, atawa kad gadoh keu geupeuwoe
migration-progress-note: Neupreh watee kamoe migrasi papan droeneueh u struktur teubaro...
conversion-info-text: Konversi nyoe geupeubuet sigoe tiep papan ngön peugöt performa leubèh got. Droeneueh jeuet neungui papan lagèe biasa.
converting-board-description: Ubah struktur papan keu fungsi nyang leubeh got. Nyoe jeuet meujan-jan.
migration-batch-size-description: Jumlah lampiran keu geuproses tiep batch (1-100)
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Reuhat migrasi watèe peungui CPU leubèh nibak persentase nyoe (10-90)
migration-info-text: Migrasi database geupeubuet sigoe ngön peugöt performa sistem leubèh got. Proses nyan mantong jijak bak latar meuskipun droeneueh tôp browser.
migration-warning-text: Neubek tutup browser watee migrasi. Proses lanjot bak latar tapi jeuet meujan-jan keu seuleusoe.
account-locked: Akun geugunci keu siat kareuna le that ci tamong nyang gagai. Neuci lom teuma.
invalid-credentials: Nan ureueng ngui atawa sandi salah
username-password-required: Nan ureueng ngui ngön sandi wajéb na
username-too-short: Nan ureueng ngui beu paléng kureueng 3 karakter
account-created: Akun ka geupeugöt! Jinoe droeneueh jeuet tamong.
problems-summary-help: Piléh wilayah masalah nyang ka gata pariksa, óh lheuh nyan klik Akui keu reset jumlah masalah barô jih.
problems-in-progress-help: Peupinah atawa peu-ubat nyoe teungoh jijak. Tamong jeuet lambat, atawa jipeuleumah "Must be logged in" atawa "Loading, please wait", sampoe seuleusoe ngön CPU treun.
problems-none-in-progress: Hana peupinah atawa peu-ubat nyang teungoh jalan.
repair-broken-cards-done-unfixable: __fixed__ kad ka geupeu-ubat. __unfixable__ kad hana papan ngön hana jeuet geupeu-ubat keudroe.
restore-list-swimlanes-done: __restored__ dapeuta ka geupeuwoe. __remaining__ hana jeuet geupeuwoe.
export-card-details: Rincian kad (tiep kad lagee lam ekspor kad)
import-board-source: Peutamong papan (Trello, Jira, ekspor WeKan, CSV, Excel, …)
import-report-description: Papan ka geupeugot, teuma na padum bagi lam fail nyang hana jeut geuba. Laporan nyang sama geukeubah bak Panel Admin → Masalah → Peuulang.
import-parts-instruction: Bagian nyang geucek mantong geupeutamong. Pilehan nyang saban geungui watee ekspor.
import-file-label: Pileh file ekspor, atawa tempel teks jih di bawah:
sum-of-number-fields: Jumlah field khusus angka nyang geutanda keu geupeuleumah di ateuh dapeuta
date-range-of-fields: Rentang tanggai field khusus tanggai nyang geutanda keu geupeuleumah di ateuh dapeuta
twoFactorAuth-enabled: Otentikasi dua faktor ka hudép keu akun droe neuh.
twoFactorAuth-explanation: Tamah lapéh keamanan bak akun droeneueh. Watèe ka hudép, droeneueh wajéb neutuléh kode nibak aplikasi otentikator tiep kali neutamong.
twoFactorAuth-scan-instructions: Scan kode QR nyoe ngön aplikasi otentikator (umpama Google Authenticator, Authy), laju neutuléh kode 6 angka nyang jipeuleumah keu peukong.
twoFactorAuth-manual-entry: Atawa tuléh kode nyoe ngon manual:
twoFactorCode-prompt: Tuléh kode otentikasi 6 angka droe neuh
twoFactorCode-invalid: Kode otentikasi hana sah. Neu-cuba lom.
subtask-done-no-permission: Droeneueh h'an jeuet ubah peu subtugas nyoe ka leusoe atawa goh
chart-forecast-none-remaining: Hana lé nyang mantong teuhah - bandum kad ka seuleusoe.
chart-forecast-no-velocity: __remaining__ kad mantong teuhah; hana nyang ka seuleusoe barô-barô nyoe keu meurakoe tanggai.
chart-forecast-projected: Ngön laju barô-barô nyoe __average__ kad/minggu, __remaining__ kad nyang mantong teuhah patôt seuleusoe sampoe __date__.
list-sync-description: Peubarô dapeuta nyoe nibak tracker luwa. Buet di likôt layar geupriksa tiep 15 menit; ngui "Peusaban jinoe" keu priksa langsong.
drag-to-reorder: Tarék keu meuubah urutan. Tombôi panah u ateueh ngon u miyup geupeupinah saboh teumpat.
map-view-empty: Papan nyoe gohlom na gamba peta. Ureueng nyang peuatur papan jeuet peuék saboh gamba — denah lantai, peta teumpat atawa gamba tuléh — teuma kad jeuet geupeuduek di ateueh gamba nyan.
map-view-place-hint: Tarek saboh kad u ateueh peta, atawa piléh kad nyan teuma klik bak teumpat nyang patot.
map-view-all-placed: Bandum kad na di ateueh peta.
flow-error: Hana jeuet peuluwa laporan. Priksa nilai teuma neucuba lom.
flow-note-agingWip: Kad teuhah: jumeulah uroe sit tamong u tahap jinoe. Bar mirah leubèh nibak persentil 85 sejarah tahap nyan (paleng hana limong go duek). Sejarah tamong nyang hana na hana geuteupeu.
flow-note-blockerAnalysis: Sejarah gantungan geubri watèe phôn/akhé peuhambat bak tiep tahap. Hubungan awai jeuet hana geuteupeu watèe phôn. Kad nyang ka geuhapus peureulee simpanan sejarah. Sabab nyang meutimpa geuhitong meupisah.
flow-note-monteCarlo: 2.000 cuba geucok nibak uroe kalender UTC peunoh, ngön uroe nyang hana hasé. Tanggai nakeuh ramalan ujông ateuh; jumeulah nakeuh janji ujông yup. Geuanggap hasé teuma saban ngön nyang ka; kon jaminan. Bataih paleng jioh: 3.650 uroe. Meunyoe hana nyang seuleusoe, hana ramalan.
flow-note-processBehavior: Watèe siklus ngui Phôn, meunyoe hana ngui watèe peugöt, ngön Akhé, meunyoe hana ngui watèe arsip. XmR peuleumah nilai sidroe-sidroe ngön beda meuurôt, ngön rata-rata ngön bataih proses alami; peureulee paleng hana dua seuleusoe nyang sah.
flow-note-sizeCycleTime: Peukira Planning Poker jinoe atawa saboh ruweueng khusuih angka geubandeng ngön watèe siklus nyang ka seuleusoe lam uroe. Peukira nyang hana na ngön tanggai nyang hana sah hana geuruek. Phôn meunyoe hana ngui watèe peugöt; Akhé meunyoe hana ngui watèe arsip.
time-adjustment-note: Ubah jeuem nyang ka geucatat, geukumpoi meunurôt ureueng nyang ubah jumeulah. Nyoe kon sesi buet sidroe-sidroe. Nilai negatif nakeuh peubeutôi. Watèe awai nyang hana geucatat hana jeuet geupeuhubong ngön soe pih.
blockly-ANNOUNCE_CANT_SCROLL_FURTHER: Hana jeuet peugésér nyang deuh leubèh jioh lé.
blockly-ANNOUNCE_SCROLLED_DOWN: Nyang deuh ka teugésér u yup.
blockly-ANNOUNCE_SCROLLED_LEFT: Nyang deuh ka teugésér u wie.

email-recovery-superseded: Buet nyang leubèh barô nibak ureueng peujak sistem ka geuganto peumintaan nyoe. Keuadaan daftar jinoe geupeuleumah.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Batal mandum peusan nyang jinoe lam daftar keu ureueng nyang teurimong nyoe? Aso jih geuboih ngon hana jeuet geupeuwoe lom. Peusan barô nyang geupeugöt lheueh peumintaan nyoe geukeubah.
email-failure-recipient-unavailable: Ureueng teurimong hana atawa akun geupeumate
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Kirém h'an jeuet geupeuseuhah; kalon sigohlom culok lom
email-failure-acknowledgement-failed: Tanda teurimong kirém h'an jeuet geukeubah
sync-time-estimate-hint: Peukira watèe jingui ruang angka watèe asli/tinggai nyang geupeugöt le impor Jira. Pah saboh ruang nyang saban beuna bak papan nyoe. Sunting lokal geukalon sibagoe konflik; nilai sumber nyang hana h'an geupeuduli ngon null nyang jeulaih geupeugléh nilai.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint ngon rilis geusinkron seulama Scrum hudep bak papan nyoe mantong. Sprint atawa rilis nyang hana geupeugöt bak papan nyoe, ngon tanggal nibak sumber; nyang ka na geupeusaban ngon ID sumber jih phon, lheuh nyan ngon nan. Peuubahan rencana lokal tetap sampoe sumber geuubah rencana isu nyan, ngon Sinkron phon h'an tom geuhapus rencana.
activity-recovery-description: Haba nyang goh leusoe geuculok lom secara otomatis. Kalon aktivitas nyang gadoh atawa meuubah sigohlom culok lom. Culok lom h'an tom geupeugöt ulang aktivitas.
activity-recovery-empty: Hana haba aktivitas nyang goh geukirém.
activity-recovery-unavailable: H'an jeuet muat haba aktivitas nyang goh geukirém.
activity-recovery-status-inconsistent: Rencana ngon aktivitas nyang goh geukirém h'an saban
activity-recovery-busy: Pekerja laen teungoh urôh haba nyoe. Peubarô ngon culok lom.
activity-recovery-denied: Akses ureueng teurimong atawa peumileh haba h'an le geubri izin kirém.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Aktivitas asli gadoh atawa ka meuubah. Hana nyang geupeugöt ulang.
activity-recovery-failed: H'an jeuet peuleusoe kirém haba. Buet nyang goh leusoe geupeutheun.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Haba nyoe ka meuubah lheuh geumuat. Kalon keuadaan nyang ka geupeubarô sigohlom culok lom.
activity-recovery-control-failed: H'an jeuet peuseuhah peuatôran kirém. Peubarô ngon kalon keuadaan jih jinoe.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Batai keu sabe kirém nyang tinggai keu aktivitas nyoe? Nyoe h'an jeuet geulanjut. Emel nyang ka lam antrian ngon haba nyang ka geukirém h'an geucok woe.
rule-email-recovery-description: Perèksa usaha kirem surat èlektronik atôran nyang ka teucatat. Usaha nyang gohlom pasti mungkén mantong teungoh kirem atawa ka teuganggu. Laporan nyoe hana jikirem lom ngon hana jipeubateuë kirem.
rule-email-recovery-sent: Ka jiteurimong lé server surat èlektronik
rule-email-recovery-invalid: Data nyang peugah bhah usaha hana sah
rule-email-recovery-empty: Hana usaha kirem surat èlektronik atôran nyang sisuai ngon mita nyoe.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: H'an jeuet muat culok emel aturan. Peubarô keu culok lom.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan hana tom jikirem lom keudroe surat èlektronik nyang gohlom pasti. Kirem lom nyan mantong keu ureuëng nyang gohlom pasti teurimong. Bôh tanda ka geukirem meunyo droeneuh neuteupeue ka trôh, atawa peubateuë.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Peungiriman nyang phon mungkén mantong meujalan. Droeneuh jeuet neupileh o lheueh __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend: Kirem lom keu ureuëng nyang gohlom pasti teurimong
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Kirem lom surat èlektronik nyoe keu ureuëng nyang gohlom pasti teurimong? So mantong nyang server surat jih ka teurimong tan peugah ubak WeKan, jih teurimong dua goe.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Bôh tanda surat èlektronik nyoe ka geukirem keu mandum? Peugot nyoe meunyo droeneuh neuteupeue ka trôh mantong.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Peubateuë surat èlektronik nyoe? Hana geukirem keu ureuëng nyang gohlom pasti teurimong.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Peungiriman nyang phon mungkén mantong meujalan. Cuba lom euntreuk.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Peungiriman ulang nyang ka leupah mungkén mantong meujalan. Cuba lom euntreuk.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Mandum ureuëng nyang teurimong ka pasti. Bôh tanda ka geukirem, beu nyan nyang geupeugot.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Server surat hana jijaweueb. Surat nyang geukirem lom mungkén ka trôh atawa hana trôh; geupeuleumah lagee mantong meujalan.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Pangurôh laén teungoh geupeuseuleusoe surat èlektronik nyoe. Cuba lom siat teuk.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Surat èlektronik nyang geukeubah hana sisuai lé ngon peucubaan nyoe, jadi hana jeuet geupeuseuleusoe di sinoe.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Catatan nyang geukeubah keu peucubaan nyoe hana beutôi, jadi hana jeuet geupeuseuleusoe di sinoe.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Hana jeuet geupeuseuleusoe surat èlektronik nyoe. Muat lom ngon cuba lom.
rule-email-legacy-heading: Surat èlektronik aturan nyang teungoh geupreh paréksa
rule-email-legacy-description: Surat èlektronik aturan nyoe geupeusiap lé versi WeKan nyang awai nyang hana geucatét nibak pat asai asoe jih, jadi WeKan hana jikirem keudroe. Paréksa dilèë peu nyang peugot aturan mantong na hak tamong, lheueh nyan peusambông lom surat mangat geupeusiap lom nibak keureutu lagee jinoe, atawa bôh surat nyan.
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Keuteurangan keureutu nibak versi nyang awai
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Peusiap lom surat èlektronik nyoe nibak keureutu lagee jinoe? Asoe jih mungkén meulaén ngon nyang ka geupeusiap dilèë.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Bôh surat èlektronik nyoe? Hana geukirem sabé-sabé.
rule-email-legacy-empty: Hana surat èlektronik aturan nyang teungoh geupreh paréksa.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Hana jeuet geumuat surat èlektronik aturan nyang teungoh geupreh paréksa. Muat lom mangat jeuet cuba lom.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Nyang peugot aturan hana hak tamong lé u keureutu nyoe, atawa aturan ka meuubah, jadi surat hana jeuet geupeusambông lom. Droeneuh jeuet neubôh.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Keugiatan nyang peuphôn surat èlektronik nyoe ka meuubah, jadi hana jeuet geupeusambông lom. Droeneuh jeuet neubôh.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Keureutu nibak asai surat èlektronik nyoe hana lé, jadi hana jeuet geupeusambông lom. Droeneuh jeuet neubôh.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Peulaksanaan aturan nyang peusiap surat èlektronik nyoe hana geukeubah lé, jadi hana jeuet geupeusambông lom. Droeneuh jeuet neubôh.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Surat èlektronik nyoe ka geukirem, ka geucuba kirem, atawa ka geubôh.
rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: Surat èlektronik nyoe ka geupeusambông lom.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Hana jeuet geupeuseuleusoe buet nyoe. Muat lom ngon cuba lom.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Operasi Sinkron Dapeuta nyang h'an jeuet geujalan lom
stuck-sync-operation-description: Tiep operasi Sinkron Dapeuta nyang ka geukeubah nyoe meuhenti bak teungoh jalan ngon h'an jeuet geupeuleusoe le, kareuna dapeuta jih geuhapus, geupeugöt ulang atawa geuatô ulang, atawa ureueng ngui nyang peuphon jih gadoh akses tuléh. Seulama saboh goh leusoe, dapeuta nyan h'an jeuet Sinkron. Boh keu bri izin dapeuta Sinkron lom: peuubahan nyang ka geuterapkan tetap, peuubahan nyang tinggai h'an tom geutuléh, ngon Sinkron lheuh nyoe geubandeng dapeuta ngon sumber jih lom.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Dapeuta ka geuhapus, geupeugöt ulang atawa peuatôran Sinkron jih meuubah
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Ureueng ngui nyang peuphon jih h'an le na akses tuléh u dapeuta peunoh
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Geukeubah le versi WeKan dilee tanpa peue nyang peuphon jih
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: Catatan soe nyang peuphon jih gadoh
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Jih jeuet geujalan lom jinoe ngon leusoe keudroe, nyan pasai h'an jeuet geuboh.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Boh operasi Sinkron Dapeuta nyang ka geukeubah nyoe? Peuubahan nyang ka geuterapkan tetap; sisa jih h'an tom geutuléh. Dapeuta lheuh nyan jeuet Sinkron lom.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Hana operasi Sinkron Dapeuta nyang teungoh preh geukalon.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: 50 nyang paleng awai mantong geupeuleumah. Boh padum boh ngon peubarô keu kalon leubeh.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: H'an jeuet muat operasi Sinkron Dapeuta. Peubarô keu culok lom.
stuck-sync-operation-missing: Operasi nyoe h'an le teungoh preh.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Operasi nyoe h'an meuteumee meusangkot, nyan pasai h'an jeuet geuboh.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Operasi nyoe jeuet geujalan lom jinoe ngon leusoe keudroe, nyan pasai h'an geuboh.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Dapeuta nyoe teungoh sinkron jinoe. Culok lom siat teuk.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Hana jeuet geupeuseuleusoe buet nyoe. Muat lom ngon cuba lom.
interrupted-import-heading: Impor papan nyang meuhenti sigohlom leusoe
interrupted-import-description: Tiep impor papan nyoe meuhenti bak teungoh jalan - server geupeuphon ulang, atawa impor gagai - ngon geutinggai papan nyang goh peunoh. Impor h'an jeuet geulanjut, kareuna file sumber jih h'an geupeutheun. Peutheun papan lagee jinoe, atawa boh ngon impor file lom. Boh geuhapus papan nyang geupeugöt le impor nyoe ngon bandum nyang na bak jih, rôh peue nyang geutamah lheuh nyan.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Teungoh geuboh; boh lom keu peuleusoe
interrupted-import-scrum: Tahap Scrum jih na titik peumeureksa keudroe (__state__, __next__ nibak __total__ langkah). Meunyoe droeneueh peutheun papan, peuleusoe atawa boh nibak pemulihan impor Scrum papan.
interrupted-import-counts: __swimlanes__ jalur, __lists__ dapeuta, __cards__ kad, __checklists__ checklist, __comments__ komen, __attachments__ lampiran
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Peutheun papan nyang goh peunoh nyoe lagee jinoe? Hana nyang geuhapus, ngon impor nyoe h'an le geutuléh sinoe.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Boh impor nyoe? Papan nyang geupeugöt ngon bandum nyang na bak jih geuhapus keu sabe.
interrupted-import-empty: Hana impor papan nyang meuputôh nyang teungoh preh geukalon.
interrupted-import-truncated: 50 nyang paleng awai mantong geupeuleumah. Peutheun atawa boh padum boh ngon peubarô keu kalon leubeh.
interrupted-import-unavailable: H'an jeuet muat impor papan nyang meuputôh. Peubarô keu culok lom.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: Impor nyoe h'an le teungoh preh keuputosan.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Papan ngon id nyoe h'an geupeugöt le impor nyoe, nyan pasai h'an geusentôh.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Tahap Scrum jih mantong teungoh geutuléh atawa geupulih. Culok lom lheuh padum menit.
interrupted-import-failed: Hana jeuet geupeuseuleusoe buet nyoe. Muat lom ngon cuba lom.
saml-login-not-started: Tamong SAML nyoe hana geupeuphon bak tab browser nyoe. Neu tamong lom, meunyoe jeuet.
history-request-pending-undo: Peuladèn gohlom geupeupasti peubatalan akhé droeneuh.
history-request-pending-redo: Peuladèn gohlom geupeupasti peubuet lom akhé droeneuh.
history-request-hint: Meunyo droeneuh cuba lom, nyan geuulang peumintaan nyang saban, jadi hana jeuet geupeubatal peugantian keudua.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Batai buet, ulang lom atawa peuwoe peuubahan Scrum meuhenti bak saboh konflik. Sunting Scrum bak papan nyoe geuhambat sampoe geupeuleusoe.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: __applied__ nibak __total__ peuubahan ka geutuléh, __pending__ goh, ngon __conflicted__ ka geuubah le ureueng laen lheuh nyan.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Peuwoe u likôt geupeuwoe bandum catatan nyang meuubah lagee sigohlom; nyoe geubri meunyoe hana ureueng laen nyang ubah catatan nyan lheuh nyan mantong. Peutheun papan lagee jinoe geuhapus operasi nyang meuhenti ngon h'an geuubah catatan pajan pih. Pajan pih, nyoe geucatat lam Panel Admin, Masalah, Pemulihan.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Peutheun bandum catatan lagee jinoe, rôh peuubahan nyang ka geutuléh le operasi nyang meuhenti?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Admin papan jeuet peuwoe u likôt atawa peutheun papan lagee jinoe.
login-setting-clear-secret: Sampôh nilai nyang ka keusimpan bak Panel Admin
login-setting-after-restart: Phôn meufungsi lheueh WeKan geupeuphôn lom
login-setting-env-only: Lingkungan server mantong nyang atô nyoe. Nyoe geupeuleumah sinoe sibagoe baca mantong.
email-to-card-description: Emel nyang geukirém u alamat papan droeneuh jeut keu kad bak papan nyan.
email-to-card-webhook: URL webhook teuka nibak ureueng bri layanan emel (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark atawa relay MIME mentah)
email-to-card-secret-saved: Ka geukeubah - peutinggai soh mangat hana meugantoe
email-to-card-clear-secret: Hapus rahsia webhook nyang ka geukeubah
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Papan nyang jeut keu tujuan emel u grain nyoe
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Hana - mantong emel nyang na token papan lam tajuk
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Peuduek nyoe lam tajuk mangat trôk u papan nyoe sibagoe droeneuh:
email-to-card-part-description: Asoe emel jeuet keu deskripsi kad
email-to-card-part-strip-quoted: Bek peuroh peusan ilé nyang geukutip
email-to-card-your-address: Alamat emel droeneuh keu papan nyoe
email-to-card-address-private: Peutheun rahsia: soe mantong nyang na jeut geutamah kad sibagoe droeneuh.
email-to-card-new-address: Alamat barô (nyang awai hana jalan lé)
email-to-card-off-admin-off: Teurimong emel goh geuatô lam Panel Admin.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Admin papan goh geupeuudep emel keu papan nyoe.
email-to-card-off-member-off: Droeneuh ka neupeumatée alamat papan lam Peuatôran Anggota.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: Grain nyoe goh na alamat emel jih. Peubarô laman.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: Droeneuh peureulee akses tuléh u papan nyoe.
inbound-domain-invalid: Nyan kon nan domain nyang sah.
inbound-account-invalid: Kotak emel IMAP peureulee nan server nyang sah.
feature-views-email-desc: Papan sibagoe kotak surat: dapeuta emel nakeuh Kotak Masok, dapeuta-dapeuta jeuet keu map, label jeuet keu label, ngon anggota geutuleh ngon geujaweub emel nibak alamat papan.
email-view-not-receiving: Papan nyoe goh lom geuteurimong emel. Peuudep bak Atô Notifikasi papan → Emel u kad.
email-view-invalid-address: Salah sa alamat nyan kon alamat emel nyang sah.
email-view-no-recipient: Tamah paleng kureueng sa ureueng nyang teurimong.
email-view-too-many-recipients: Paleng le 20 ureueng nyang teurimong bak sa peusan.
email-view-too-many: Le that emel geukirém lam sa jeum nyoe. Cuba lom eunteuk.
feature-views-chat-desc: Papan sibagoe teumpat meucurito: teumpat keurija, papan, swimlane, dapeuta ngon kad sibagoe bak kayee saluran, kad di teungoh ngon komen jih sibagoe peusan meucurito.
chat-view-message-cards: Peuleumah kad nyang na peusan mantong
chat-view-pick-card: Pileh sa kad nibak saluran mangat jeut kalon sinoe.
chat-view-no-messages: Goh na peusan. Tuleh nyang phôn.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Kad nyang sama lam meupadum kumpulan kolom nyang na nan - meunurôt seuleusoe, prioritas, tanda jalan atawa laén - geupinah antara kolom ngön ta seuet.
column-sets-empty: Goh na kumpulan kolom. Peungatô papan jeuet geupeugöt saboh: bri nan, lheuëh nyan tamah kolom jih.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Papan sabagoe pelacak isu GitHub atawa Gitea: kad sabagoe isu, label ngon tônggak, komen sabagoe peugah haba, lampiran sabagoe berkas, ngon sejarah papan ngon batai.
vcs-no-issues: Hana isu nyang pah ngon mita nyoe.
vcs-no-milestones: Goh na tônggak. Label ngon uroe bataih nakeuh tônggak.
vcs-no-list: Papan nyoe hana dapeuta atawa jalur keu isu nyoe.
card-qr-code-desc: Scan keu buka kad nyoe bak telepon atawa tablet.
card-qr-code-too-long: Link kad nyoe panyang that keu kode QR.
vcs-no-wiki: Goh na wiki. Impor organisasi GitHub jiba wiki repositori keunoe.
github-org-import-desc: Tiep repositori nibak saboh organisasi atawa ureueng jeuet keu papan droe, geupeuhah lam Board View / Version Control: isu jih ngon komen, label ngon berkah, rilis jih, alur keurija GitHub Actions jih sibagoe Aturan, ngon wiki jih.
github-org-import-token-hint: Peureulee keu repositori khusus ngon had API nyang leubeh manyang. Geungui cit watèe impor teungoh jalan ngon hana geukeubah.
github-org-import-issues: Isu, ngon komen, label ngon berkah
github-org-import-actions: Alur keurija GitHub Actions sibagoe Aturan
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Tuléh nan organisasi atawa ureueng, atawa alamat GitHub jih.
optional-apis-desc: REST API lagèe API tracker laén, mangat aplikasi ngon skrip jih jeuet jipakè WeKan nyoe sibagoe backend jih: peue nyang jikeubah teukeubah lam WeKan, bak papan WeKan. Tiep-tiep saboh mate sampoe ta-centang inoe. Hana saboh pih nyang na hak droe: klien tamöng ngon token API WeKan ngon jeuet jikalon ngon jigantoe cit peue nyang ureueng nyan jeuet jikalon ngon jigantoe lam WeKan. Mandum jih peureulèe WeKan REST API udép (WITH_API=true). Alamat di yup tiep-tiep saboh nakeuh nyang jipakè le klien sibagoe server jih.
optional-api-trello-desc: Aplikasi ngon skrip nyang geutuléh keu REST API Trello (contoh jih Trellinator) jeuet jipakè ngon WeKan: papan, dapeuta, kad, label, anggota, komen ngon dapeuta peureksa. Token Trello nakeuh token API WeKan. Peugadoh kad jeuet jipinah u arsip lam WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Klien REST API v2 Jira jeuet jipakè ngon WeKan: proyek nakeuh papan (gunci jih nakeuh gunci papan), isu nakeuh kad (DEV-7), status nakeuh dapeuta, ngon transisi jipinah kad. Mita jitém JQL nyang mudah: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text ngon ORDER BY. Tamöng ngon token API WeKan sibagoe lageuem rahsia. Peugadoh isu jipinah u arsip.
optional-api-github-desc: Klien REST API GitHub keu isu jeuet jipakè ngon WeKan: repositori nakeuh papan, isu nakeuh kad, ngon label, tônggak (label ngon tanggai abéh), komen, ngon buka atawa geutôp lagèe lam Peuleumah Papan / Kontrol Versi. Token nakeuh token API WeKan.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Klien REST API Gitea ngon Forgejo keu isu jeuet jipakè ngon WeKan, lagèe API nyang cocok ngon GitHub: repositori nakeuh papan ngon isu nakeuh kad. Token nakeuh token API WeKan.
bots-none: Hana bot lom. Bot nakeuh runner bak server droeneuh - agen AI, buet CI, skrip - nyang papan nyoe jok kad.
bot-not-found: Bot nyan hana bak papan nyoe.
bot-option-not-found: Jaweuëb nyan kon nyang geujok lé bot.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Webhook Teubiet hana jeuet geujak u alamat bak jaringan WeKan keudroe, mangat hana soe jeuet geutunjok webhook panel u layanan dalam. Tuléh sinoe host bak jaringan nyan nyang jeuet geujak lé webhook - saboh Node-RED, saboh server chat - saboh bak tiep baréh, sabagoe nan atawa alamat, ngon port mangat geuizin port nyan mantong. Soh: hana. Peungatô situs mantong nyang jeuet geuubah daftar nyoe.
account-webhook-desc: Saboh alamat nyang WeKan peugah watee na ureueng tamong atawa akun barô geupeugot. Hana sapeue nyang geukirém sampoe na peristiwa di yup nyoe geuteukan. Webhook nyoe geuba peristiwa, nan ureueng ngui ngon watee; teuken bidang laén mantong meunyoe peunerima peureulee.
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Batai mandum notifikasi aktivitas nyang goh geukirem keu aktivitas nyang leubeh trép nibak padum uroe?
activity-recovery-bulk-result: Ka geubatai %s, ka geukirem %s, %s nyang leubeh trép mantong goh geukirem.
vcs-synced-from: Ka disinkron dari %s: buka ngon tôp bak sinan.
vcs-synced-issue: Isu nyoe ka disinkron: buka ngon tôp bak pelacak jih.
sync-write-back: Tuléh peubah keulayi u GitLab: judul, deskripsi, komen, tôp ngon peuhah lom
email-bounces-description: Peue nyang geupeubuet lé WeKan ngon emel nyang geuwoe: alamat nyang salah tuléh, kotak surat nyang peunoh, jaweueb hana di kantô, keuluhan spam. Tiep jeunèh na buet droe, nyang geupeubuet watée ka geuwoe meunan le go.
email-bounces-enabled: Urôh emel nyang geuwoe lam WeKan
email-bounces-action-stop-email: Piyôh kirém emel u alamat nyan
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Alamat nyan hana: salah tuléh, akun ka geusampôh, domain hana geuturi.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Goh trôk jinoe: kotak surat peunoh, server sibôk. Meunyo le go meuturôt mantong na maksud.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Hana di kantô, cuti atawa jaweueb sistem tiket. Emel nyan ka trôk.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: Nyang teurimong ka geutanda emel nyan sibagoe spam.
email-bounces-ses-description: Lam Amazon SES, kirém peuriwang Bounce ngon Complaint, ngon aturan teurimong keu alamat nyang WeKan kirém, u topik SNS, laju peudaftar alamat nyoe bak topik nyan meulalui HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: ARN topik SNS nyang geuteurimong, saboh tiep baréh
email-bounces-stopped-only: Alamat nyang hana le geukirém emel lé WeKan mantong
email-bounces-clear-hint: Tuwo geuwoe alamat nyoe laju kirém emel lom
email-bounces-providers-description: Meunyoe WeKan geukirém meulalui salah saboh layanan nyoe, peu-udép layanan nyan, bri keu layanan nyan alamat webhook nyoe keu haba emel nyang geuwoe ngon keuluhan spam, laju pasoe keunoe gunci nyang geungui keu teken, atawa sandi nyang neuboh lam alamat lagée https://user:password@… atawa ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Layanan nyang ka geupeu-udép peureulee gunci tanda atawa sandi jih.
activity-pub-enabled: Papan publik geupeuteubiet buet kad jih bak fediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Geupadam meunurot asai. Meunyoe geupeuudep, tiep papan publik jeuet geuseutot nibak Mastodon ngon server fediverse laen sebagai @board-<id> bak alamat WeKan nyoe, ngon buet kad baro trôh bak ureuëng nyang seutot. Nyoe keu beuet mantong: hana sapeue nyang geukirém lé server fediverse jeuet geugantoe papan, ngon papan pribadi hana tom geupeuteubiet.
caldav-sync-desc: Peuduek uroe bataih kad papan nyoe lam almanak - Nextcloud Calendar atawa almanak CalDAV laen. Uroe bataih nyang geupinah lam almanak jigisa u kad. Ngui kata sandi aplikasi, kon kata sandi droeneuh.
caldav-enabled: Sinkronkan uroe bataih ngon almanak nyoe
caldav-invalid-url: Alamat almanak wajeb alamat http:// atawa https://, hana nan ureuëng ngui atawa kata sandi lam jih.
caldav-not-linked: Keubah alamat almanak dilèe ngon peuudep sinkronisasi.
webdav-storage-description: Keubah lampiran lam map bak server WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud atawa nyang laen. Ngui kata sandi aplikasi nyang geupeugöt keu WeKan. Server bak jaringan WeKan keudroe jeuet geungui ino, sabab admin situs mantong nyang peuteutap alamat nyoe.
sqrl-desc: Geupadam meunurot asai. Meunyo geupeuudép, laman tamong geubri SQRL, dan anggota phon that geutamah identitas SQRL droe jih bak Peuatôran Anggota. SQRL peureulee WeKan bak alamat https://.
sqrl-scan: Pindai kode nyoe ngon aplikasi SQRL droeneuh, atawa peuhah klien SQRL droeneuh bak alat nyoe.
sqrl-expired: Kode SQRL nyoe ka abéh masa. Mulai lom.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL peureulee WeKan bak alamat https://.
sqrl-description: Tamong ngon identitas SQRL droeneuh, kon ngon kata sandi. Tamah sigo sinoe ngon klien SQRL droeneuh; droeneuh jeuet neuhapus nyan sinoe kapan mantong.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Tamong ngon SQRL ka geupadam keu akun nyoe nibak klien SQRL droeneuh. Peuudép lom keudéh ngon kode peuseulamat droeneuh.
sqrl-only-on: Klien SQRL droeneuh ka geukunci akun nyoe keu SQRL: ban mandum cara tamong laen geutulak.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Klien SQRL droeneuh ka geukunci kong akun nyoe: peuglah kata sandi ngon gantoe emel geutulak.
sqrl-only: Akun nyoe tamong ngon SQRL mantong.
sqrl-hardlock: Akun nyoe ka geukunci keu SQRL: hana jeuet geupeuglah atawa geugantoe ngon cara laen.
windows-sso-failed: Tamong ngon Windows hana jeut. Akun Windows droeneuh mungkin hana geuizin di sinoe.
